M1 one valid outcome product/combination probability; A1 one fully correct identified outcome; M1 sum of all three; A1 $2040/3360=17/28=0.607$. Method 2: $1-[P(WSS)+P(WWS)+P(WWW)+P(BSS)+P(BBS)+P(BBB)+P(SSS)]$, with respective numerators over 3360: 144,504,336,90,180,60,6; M1 two valid products and attempt at complement, A1 two fully correct, M1 complement of all seven, A1 same result. SC1 for final result WWW if a method mark is missed. [4]
